bio.text: George Whitesides is serving his first term representing California's 27th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served as Chief of Staff at NASA during the Obama administration, and later was the first CEO of Virgin Galactic.
He sits on the House Armed Services Committee and the House Science, Space, and Technology Committee.
